summary: Full RBAC + password change + admin management + transfer-master testing completed. Backend: 22/22 pytest cases pass (test_rbac.py). Frontend: full master and non-master flows verified — sidebar conditional items, add admin dialog, my account page, delete admin, non-master redirect from /admin/users. Master role restored to ding.jiae@gmail.com and all test admin accounts cleaned up (including a stray deputy@utem24fd.com leftover from a prior UI run).

issues: At viewport heights <= ~950px (e.g., 1440x900) the last nav items ('Settings', 'My Account', 'Admin Users') are pushed below the fold and get overlapped/hidden by the absolutely-positioned user info + Logout footer. Sidebar <nav> doesn't scroll, causing bottom items to be inaccessible on smaller laptop screens. Consider making the sidebar/nav overflow-y-auto or moving the user footer inside the flex column.

action_items: (Design only) Fix AdminLayout sidebar overflow so 'Settings', 'My Account', and 'Admin Users' remain reachable at 900px viewport heights — the absolute-positioned user/logout block currently overlays the last few menu items.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~985 lines and growing — consider splitting into modules (auth/rbac, media, content) for maintainability.
getAuth() helper is duplicated across AdminAccount.jsx and AdminUsers.jsx — extract into a shared utility (e.g., src/lib/auth.js).

AdminLayout sidebar rendering: user prop is optional and can be undefined during first render → conditional 'My Account'/'Admin Users' items briefly missing until /auth/me resolves. Consider hoisting user fetch into a context/provider so all admin pages share a single stable user.

transfer-master is not atomic (two sequential update_one calls). If the second call fails, the system ends up with zero masters. Consider wrapping in a MongoDB transaction or at minimum re-promoting the caller on failure.
seed_data_creation: None — all created test admins (ui_admin_*, test_admin_*, pwd_test_*, transfer_target_*) were deleted after tests. Also removed stray deputy@utem24fd.com from prior iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: RBAC is fully working. Only master ding.jiae@gmail.com exists. Backend regression suite includes /app/backend/tests/test_rbac.py covering login role, /auth/me role, admin CRUD (list/create/duplicate/short-pw/delete self/delete unknown/delete success), password change (auth/wrong-old/short-new/success + other-session invalidation), and transfer-master (non-master 403 / wrong pw 401 / success + verify listing + transfer back). Frontend AdminLayout has a viewport-height issue at <=900px that the main agent should consider fixing (nav overflow behind absolute-positioned user footer).
